claims.evidence: Witness report shows an engine assembly with no readable brand/model markings; no proof of origin (Korea) is visible.

risks.risk: Exact engine make/model and engine code are not readable, so vehicle compatibility and correct parts matching are uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/serial plate and any readable brand/model markings (e.g., on block/head) plus a photo of the ECU/engine label if included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unidentified engine assembly with unknown compatibility; treated as higher risk for mismatch.

risks.risk: Unknown mechanical condition (compression/leaks) and whether it was running before removal.
risks.proof: Video/clip of the engine running (or a compression/leak test sheet with readings) and a short clip showing it cranks smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working; treated as for spares/repair risk.

risks.risk: Missing or replaced critical components/sensors/brackets/covers cannot be confirmed from the provided view.
risks.proof: A full set of photos showing all included parts laid out (sensors, brackets, covers, hoses, ECU if any) and a checklist photo against what is claimed included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially incomplete; assume missing small parts/sensors that affect installation.

risks.risk: Critical internal/timing components condition is not visible (timing chain/belt, cylinder head, crank bearings).
risks.proof: Photos of timing cover area (or removed cover showing timing components) and close-ups of cylinder head/crank area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case internal wear risk; assume timing/internal service may be required.

risks.risk: Unclear what accessories are included (ECU, starter, alternator, turbo, injectors).
risks.proof: Photos of the full accessory list included in the sale, including ECU label, starter, alternator, injectors/turbo (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine-only or incomplete accessory bundle; buyer may need to source missing parts.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the engine code/serial plate and any readable brand/model markings on the block/head.
Provide a video clip showing the engine cranking/running (or provide compression and leak test results).
Lay out all included parts (sensors, brackets, covers, hoses, ECU, starter, alternator, injectors/turbo if any) and send photos of the full set.
Show the timing area (timing cover/timing components) or provide proof of recent timing service if the cover cannot be removed.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an engine assembly, but the make/model, engine code, and working condition are not verifiable from the report. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
